reviewScope.mechanical: All 33 page records and 460 source occurrences: disjoint page ranges, unique IDs, allowed statuses, source references, existing lesson/knowledge/paragraph identifiers and status counts.
reviewScope.semantic: Targeted source image and canonical prose review of historical production/self-sufficiency figures, flower numeric charts and graph inconsistencies, flowering examples, nursery selection and benefits, transplanting diagrams, graft labels/purposes, and direct-seeding stage wording. reviewScope.routeCoverageCheck: Targeted GENERAL-0040 and GENERAL-0091: source-book minimum level 1; checked actual shared-route alternatives across all canonical level-1 paragraphs. Other authored occurrences were not independently route-audited.
